# m8 contact sheet — colour unverified: character grids, no colour (rule 5)
# Part 1 of 3 (m8-contact-sheet-1.txt … m8-contact-sheet-3.txt), each at most 180 000 B.
#
# Promise: it stays smooth on your biggest repo, looks like the mock-up, installs with one command, and teaches itself from inside the app — the mock-up's scenes (m8-proto-*) first, then every M8 capture in ticket order; each journey of the note's fence is walked at or under its count (TESTING.md "M8").
#
# Generated by scripts/contact-sheet.sh — do not hand-edit; edit
# m8-contact-sheet-captions.tsv and re-run instead.
#
# 109 captures in all, in ticket order.
#
# These are character-grid captures (pyte/TestBackend), not pixels:
# colour is never verifiable from this file. Judge colour only in a
# real terminal, never from a capture (CLAUDE.md rule 5).
#
# Scroll once: each capture is delimited by a heading naming its
# file (docs/shots/<name>) and what right looks like for it.
